title: Celestin's band: arrangers and trumpet section, 1933-35
summary: Turner names Celestin's arrangers and trumpets, and says he worked and traveled with the band between 1933 and 1935.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about different arranges. Did Herman Franklin ever do any arranging?

Well, Celestan, he had, uh, Hummer used to do a little arranging, Kildee used to do arranging. Somebody else up there. Then he used to buy, Caesar used to arrange for them too sometimes. Caesar, Cyclo, Clyclo. He used to have arranging for them. He used to buy arranging for different guys. Well, now we have to go over the Celestan band again. I think that was on the side of the tape. It didn't work. Who was the first trumpet with Celestan? The one, uh, was Herman Franklin that I remember when I was working with. The brass was Herman Franklin, Bill Matthews, and Kilby. When was that you were working with Celestan?

That was in the thirties. When, and Mrs. Kimball was having a- Between thirty-five, between thirty-three and thirty-five. That's when you were traveling with the band? Yeah, I was traveling. Booking. You said you switched to the band. You said you switched to the band.

She played for Sunday South, and I was playing, I was playing at her place with Celestan. You traveled all over the South? Right, Florida, Texas, Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia. We went all through Arkansas, but I took sick at the time, I couldn't go with them. You bought the piece on one of them. I think it was at that time.
Now back to- What part did Kildee play on trumpet? Was he second or third?
No, let me see. Kildee was- Celestan was played. Herman was second, Kildee was third.
